user.title: Yandex application
user.description: Create an app at https://oauth.yandex.ru/client/new/ — platform «Web services», Yandex.Disk REST API scopes for read, write and info. Yandex fills the redirect URI itself; leave it as is. Paste the app's ClientID and secret here.

code.title: Grant access to Disk
code.description: Open the [authorization page]({authorize_url}), press «Allow» and paste the confirmation code Yandex shows. The code is needed once: access is refreshed automatically afterwards.

folder.title: Backup folder
folder.description: Disk {login} is connected. Backups will live in this folder; it is created if missing.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-confirm access
reauth_confirm.description: Yandex no longer accepts the stored access. Press Submit — a new confirmation code is needed.

error.invalid_code: The code did not work — it is single-use and short-lived, get a new one
error.cannot_create_folder: Could not create the folder — check the app scopes and free space

abort.wrong_account: That is a different Yandex account

init.title: Backup folder
init.description: New backups go to this folder. Already uploaded ones stay where they are.

error.cannot_create_folder: Could not create the folder — check the app scopes and free space

token_refresh_failed.message: Yandex revoked the access — confirm it again
